config.voicechat_mic_indicator.title: Voice Chat Mic Indicator
config.voicechat_mic_indicator.enabled.t: Turn the over-the-head microphone indicator on or off.
config.voicechat_mic_indicator.show_self: Show the indicator above your own head (third person only).
config.voicechat_mic_indicator.size.tool: Size of the icon, in pixels.
config.voicechat_mic_indicator.height.to: How high above the head the icon sits, in blocks.
Maximum distance at which the icon is drawn, in blocks.
config.voicechat_mic_indicator.through_w: When on, the icon shows even when the player is behind blocks.
config.voicechat_mic_indicator.pulse.too: The icon grows slightly when the player talks louder.
config.voicechat_mic_indicator.fade.tool: Smoothly fade the icon in and out instead of popping on and off.
